description: Rubrics for protein-lab experiments. Based on Tau Ceti (Lean FRO, 2026) binary-gate model: 4 blocking gates + 3 non-blocking rubrics.

goals_declared.g_a: Identify causal mechanisms of fibromyalgia via E-values, ORA, STRING deconvolution
goals_declared.g_b: Develop falsifiable deconvolution methodology (E-values → ORA → STRING → ESM3 → GNN)
goals_declared.g_c: Produce preprints for publication (bioRxiv, not medRxiv)
goals_declared.tension: g_c pushes for over-interpretation; g_a demands caution. g_b sometimes competes: rigorous method requires declaring negative results.

known_limitations.description: ESM3 guided generation requires Colab (browser automation is down locally). The spec is ready but execution is blocked on @user opening Colab.
known_limitations.impact: G2 can block ESM3 specs that declare consumers (FoldX, Vina) that are not yet executed.

known_limitations.description: GNN architecture is designed but not trained. E-values declared as NOT_CONSUMED until training runs.
known_limitations.impact: Under G2, e_value features must be declared NOT_CONSUMED until GNN executes.

known_limitations: G1-G4 are all local: they read the artefact against itself. G5 is the first gate in this rubric that requires a network call, so it cannot run offline and it fails open if a registry is unreachable — that failure must be recorded as UNVERIFIED, never as PASS.

implementation_notes.auditor_strategy: Two options under discussion: (a) @CRITICO runs 4 sequential passes, one per gate; (b) labs cross-audit (each lab audits the gates of another lab, never their own). Tau Ceti uses parallel agents — we have one @CRITICO, so sequential is default.
implementation_notes.human_override: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Per Tau Ceti: humans write roadmaps and spot-check downstream, but do not rescue individual records. If a gate systematically blocks legitimate work, sharpen its block_when.
implementation_notes.untrusted_author_input: natural_friction and process_trace are written by the author — they are evidence, not ground truth. @CRITICO must verify them against the diff, not read them as declarations.

blocking_gates.question: ¿En qué régimen vale el número titular, y está declarado?
blocking_gates.description: Every headline number must have its regime declared (magnitude range, identity threshold, statistical method).
blocking_gates.not_your_concern: If the regime itself is scientifically interesting, that is not your concern — only whether it is declared and matches the computation.
blocking_gates.block_when: Regime is missing, or declared regime does not match the computation.

blocking_gates.question: ¿Todo campo declarado tiene algo que lo consuma en el mismo registro?
blocking_gates.description: Every declared field must have a consumer: a decision, a calculation, a kill criterion. If nothing consumes it, declare it NOT_CONSUMED with reason.
blocking_gates.not_your_concern: Whether the consumer is scientifically valuable — only whether it exists.
blocking_gates.block_when: A field is declared but no consumer is named, and it is not marked NOT_CONSUMED.

protein_examples.pass: decision_contingent_on_estimate: NOT_CONSUMED (no lab decision depends on exact T-count)
protein_examples.fail: decision_contingent_on_estimate: FORMALLY EMPTY (reads as rigor but is unfalsifiable)

blocking_gates.question: ¿Las cifras y proyecciones viven en el mismo eje?
blocking_gates.description: If a result and a projection use different axes (logical vs physical qubits, fidelity vs width, breakdown vs discovery), they must not be conflated in the same table.
blocking_gates.not_your_concern: Which axis is the right one for the science — only whether they are mixed.
blocking_gates.block_when: A table mixes axes without explicit declaration, or a projection assumes progress on one axis to date progress on another.

protein_examples.pass: STRING combined_score (0-1) used for network weight; E-value used for node feature — different axes, not mixed
protein_examples.fail: Using E-value as a continuous score AND as a binary threshold in the same analysis without declaring the axis switch

blocking_gates.question: ¿Las fuentes están verificadas independientemente del canal que las trajo?
blocking_gates.description: Every DOI/source must be resolvable via an independent method (Crossref API via urllib, not the same scraper that suggested it).
blocking_gates.not_your_concern: Whether the source is correct — only whether it was verified independently.
blocking_gates.block_when: A DOI is cited but cannot be resolved, or the same agent that suggested it also verified it.

protein_examples.pass: 10.1126/science.ads0018 resolved via api.crossref.org/works/ by @nyx and @prisma independently
protein_examples.fail: 10.1126/science.ads0018 reported by @eidel via firecrawl, no independent resolution

blocking_gates.rule: Every identifier that points at a resource outside this workspace — PDB ID, UniProt accession, DOI, dataset catalogue ID — must be resolved against that resource, and the returned object's organism, length, gene name and title checked against what the artefact claims about it.
blocking_gates.block_when: An external identifier is cited and either (a) was never resolved against its registry in this session, or (b) resolves to an object whose organism / length / accession differs from what the artefact declares.
blocking_gates.why_declared_vs_actual_is_not_enough: declared_vs_actual compares an artefact against itself. 'receptor_pdb: 6DDE' is a valid string, internally consistent with every other field, and points at a mouse receptor while the prompt is human. No local diff detects that. Only a network call to data.rcsb.org does.
blocking_gates.evidence_of_value: Caught on first application: 6DDE (Mus musculus P42866) was the docking receptor for variants of human P35372 through three prior audits. Same defect found in the TRPV1 panel (7L2P/5IRZ are Rattus norvegicus O35433).
blocking_gates.cost: one HTTP GET per identifier; seconds

blocking_gates.rule: A control arm's stated invariant (composition, Hamming distance, length, degree) must be measured on the stored sequences and the measurement recorded in the artefact.
blocking_gates.block_when: An arm declares an invariant that the stored data does not satisfy.
blocking_gates.evidence_of_value: mutated_70pct declared 'same_as_OPRM1' composition; measured mean L1 deviation from P35372 composition = 71.1 (shuffled = 0.0). @CRITICO measured it, I had not. Fix: description corrected AND a genuine composition-matched arm added, which turns a fixed error into a deconvolution the experiment lacked.

non_blocking_rubrics.question: ¿Se barrió el espacio de parámetros, o se reporta un punto?
non_blocking_rubrics.description: If a result depends on a parameter (N, threshold, identity range), the parameter space must be swept or the sensitivity declared.
non_blocking_rubrics.request_changes: Report the sweep range, or state explicitly: 'single point, sensitivity not assessed'.

non_blocking_rubrics.question: ¿Lo difícil está señalado, o las 20 filas pesan igual?
non_blocking_rubrics.description: The reader must know what was difficult, where the pipeline almost failed, what was unexpected.
non_blocking_rubrics.request_changes: Add natural_friction field (≤100 chars): what was the hard part?

non_blocking_rubrics.question: ¿Está en la línea declarada del lab?
non_blocking_rubrics.description: The experiment must fall within the declared scope of the protein-lab: fibromialgia in-silico, protein folding, free energy, deconvolución col9a1/ptn.
non_blocking_rubrics.request_changes: Declare scope explicitly if not obvious.

hash_method: sha256(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)) computed over the full object EXCLUDING the hash field itself
